checks: Current EU noncommercial dog, cat and ferret travel rules generally require identification, valid rabies vaccination and an accompanying veterinary passport for movement from another EU country.
Covered movements between EU jurisdictions under Delegated Regulation 2026/131; separately listed overseas or special destinations excluded from this record
Older documents and markings may qualify. Check route, animal age, number, owner travel timing, national derogations and any first-entry documentation from outside the EU.
For covered travel with a pet dog, the Commission identifies veterinary tapeworm treatment 24 to 120 hours before scheduled entry to these destinations, recorded in the passport.
Covered dog movements to Finland, Ireland, Malta and Norway; cats and ferrets are outside this treatment rule
Direct journeys between listed tapeworm-free jurisdictions can qualify for an exemption. Check itinerary and national implementation.

Directive 2019/904 requires Member States to restrict the placing on the market of listed single-use plastic products and oxo-degradable plastics. The Commission identifies examples including expanded-polystyrene beverage containers.
EU market-supply framework; core Member State entries only; context for available products
This verifies a supply rule only. Verify national implementation and check accompanied baggage, border entry, and personal possession independently.
Article 6 of the Habitats Directive provides for site-specific conservation measures and requires Member States to prevent qualifying habitat deterioration and disturbance at Natura 2000 sites.
Designated Natura 2000 sites within applicable Member State territory; no extension to separately listed overseas or special destinations
The framework alone establishes neither a visitor permit nor a site closure. Obtain the specific site's closures, permitted activities, seasonal conditions and competent authority.
HMRC requires declaration at EUR 10,000 or more in covered cash between Northern Ireland and a non-EU country and on arrivals from Great Britain. Family or group totals apply.
Northern Ireland only; direction and route-specific cash controls
HMRC describes an exemption for the Northern Ireland to Great Britain direction. Check covered instruments and international onward legs.

The general UK goods declaration page uses more than GBP 10,000 in referring readers to the dedicated cash page. The dedicated HMRC cash page states GBP 10,000 or more for covered Great Britain routes.
Great Britain; equality at the threshold and scope of the general goods page
UK Government and HM Revenue & Customs
Read alongside https://www.gov.uk/bringing-cash-into-uk and verify the underlying legal provision before publishing wording.

The European Commission confirms provisional application since 15 July 2026. Article 30 generally removes person checks between Gibraltar and territory fully applying Schengen, subject to sea-border provisions and temporary reinstatement. This does not extend to arrivals from outside the covered area.
Gibraltar and covered Schengen routes under the provisional EU–UK agreement

Check operational procedures, route, passport, visa, residency and temporary border controls. Commission application notice: https://commission.europa.eu/strategy-and-policy/relations-united-kingdom/eu-uk-agreement-respect-gibraltar_en

Current Health Canada guidance sets up to 90 days at the usual dose for covered prescribed controlled substances, requires a suitably labelled healthcare container and calls for declaration to customs on arrival.
Canada; controlled prescription medicine accompanied by the eligible patient or responsible traveler
Check the substance, its legal category, Class A precursor rules, and Health Canada exemptions for longer stays. Cannabis is separately regulated.
CBSA requires nonresidents and temporary residents to declare their alcohol, tobacco and vaping products on entry. Minimum age, quantity and excise conditions apply.
Canada; visitor or temporary-resident baggage; alcohol age depends on entry province or territory
Check product and stamp status, excise quantities, age and the temporary import treatment. Returning resident allowances have separate rules.
Northern Territory guidance identifies entry permits or activity permits for certain remote visits or activities on Aboriginal land.
Northern Territory, Australia; covered Aboriginal land and planned activity
Check the relevant land council, designated roads, land boundaries and activity-specific permissions.
Kakadu National Park directs travelers to obtain permission for covered commercial filming and photography, while distinguishing personal snapshots.
Kakadu National Park; purpose-specific photography and filming permit
Check cultural site restrictions and closure signs even for personal photography. Other parks and aerial filming require separate review.
The ACMA permits qualifying overseas amateur radio operators to operate under Australia's class licence for up to 365 days under stated conditions, including call sign and frequency rules.
Australia; visiting overseas amateur-radio licensees meeting ACMA eligibility
Check issuer, class, current special arrangements and bands. Import, satellite telephone, and ordinary phone use are separate.

New Zealand's Department of Conservation administers permits for filming on public conservation land and recognizes an exception for qualifying low-impact news coverage in places open to the general public.
New Zealand public conservation land; filming activity and site access
Check purpose, equipment, site closures, cultural restrictions and whether drones are involved.
Macao Customs identifies MOP 120,000 or equivalent at or above which covered inbound cash and bearer instruments are declared. On departure a submission is required on request by Customs.
Macao SAR; inbound versus outbound traveler reporting
Check how funds are aggregated, actual transit status, and the legal instrument definitions. Hong Kong and mainland China have separate rules.
Taiwan Customs lists distinct declaration thresholds for TWD, RMB, other foreign currency and negotiable instruments, including more than TWD 100,000 for covered Taiwan dollar cash.
Taiwan customs; inbound and outbound passenger reporting
Check the limit or approval for carrying excess TWD, category-specific thresholds and inspection steps. Declaration does not itself authorize excess currency.

Article 44 of the federal cybercrime decree includes electronically taking or keeping photographs of third parties in its provision on intentional invasion of privacy without consent or legal authorization.
UAE; Article 44 privacy-related use of information technology or systems
Check statutory intent and consent conditions, controlling language, exceptions and separate rules for particular venues and emirates.
Singapore's Maintenance of Religious Harmony Act covers specified religion-related conduct and permits restraining orders in defined circumstances.
Singapore; statutory religion-related conduct and restraining order provisions
Verify the applicable elements in the consolidated Act, including the applicable offence and restraining-order provisions, before presenting specific traveler guidance.
